summary: "denied: requested access to the resource is denied, unauthorized: Insufficient permissions" when pulling an EE from a protected private automation hub means the EE has no registry credential; edit the EE under Administration > Execution Environments and assign the hub's Registry credential.
questions: Why do jobs fail with insufficient permissions pulling from private automation hub?
How do I add a registry credential to an execution environment?
What does 'requested access to the resource is denied' mean in AAP?
